name: EnterpriseGPT
summary: EnterpriseGPT from GFT is an advanced generative AI platform. It enables organisations to take advantage of generative AI in a secure, compliant and cost-effective way.
description:
GFT EnterpriseGPT: Your solution for secure, efficient and compliant AI

With GFT EnterpriseGPT, you can revolutionise your business processes through the secure and cost-efficient use of state-of-the-art GPT technology. The platform can be seamlessly integrated into your existing infrastructure within a very short time and supports all common language models. Thanks to advanced security measures

highlights.highlightContent: EnterpriseGPT can be used for a variety of standard use cases such as chat, document chat or search assistance. New use cases can be integrated as plugins.
EnterpriseGPT is trustworthy because it generates verifiable, fact-based answers. Users also have the option of easily verifying all parts of the generated response.
EnterpriseGPT is secure and compliant as it fulfils strict data protection guidelines and effectively protects sensitive data. Companies can use the platform in data-sensitive environments.
EnterpriseGPT can be easily extended by connecting external data sources. This provides users with information from your confluence, sharepoint or web searches.
